_README: KAMO rating prompt — live configuration, read by kamo-app/storeReview.js. Edit, commit,
push: GitHub Pages serves it in a couple of minutes and every device picks it up on its
NEXT launch. No build, no App Store review.
⚠️ INERT UNTIL THE BUILD AFTER 1.0.9. The code that reads this file does not exist in any
released binary yet. Until that ships, every value here is decoration and the constants
compiled into storeReview.js are what actually run.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. August, rate_app_ask_outcome: 533 attempts, 452 of them dead on
`not_eligible_yet` (85%), 43 inside the cooldown, 17 with StoreReview unavailable, 12
below the score floor, 5 declined — and 4 people, total, ever reached Apple's sheet. The
data named the wrong number within a day. Fixing it needed a build and a review, which at
the time meant a fortnight. Ratings are the binding ASO constraint across this portfolio,
so a tuning loop measured in weeks is not a tuning loop.
finishesBeforeAsk WAS 2 and is the reason for most of those 452. It gates the 'retake'
trigger — the volume one, fired when someone finishes a hide and starts another. At 2 it
wanted a THIRD hide before the second could ask. 1 asks on the second, which is still a
repeat: they finished one and came back for more. Nothing else about the moment changes.
sharesBeforeAsk stays 1 — already the floor. Note its trigger only fires on a CONFIRMED
share or camera-roll write, and the write was throwing on a missing Photos permission
until the same build that reads this file. Expect this path to wake up on its own.
maxHardAsks cannot exceed 3: that is Apple's own limit on requestReview() per 365 days.
A larger number here would not ask more, it would only make the analytics lie.
minScore is the hidden-% below which we never ask — someone who botched the camouflage is
being asked to rate their own failure, and that buys 3-star reviews.
enabled:false is the kill switch: no soft-ask, no sheet, nothing spent.
Anything invalid is ignored field by field and falls back to what shipped in the binary,
so a typo costs you that one value, never the feature.
body: A quick rating really helps KAMO grow 💚
